mapper.select: select id, contractor_id, person_id, audit_status, auditor, remark, creator, open_status from cbs.t_contractor_person where contractor_id = #{contractorId} and person_id = #{personId} order by open_status desc limit 1
mapper.insert: insert into cbs.t_contractor_person (id, contractor_id, person_id, audit_status, audit_time, auditor, remark, creator, open_status) values (#{p.id}, #{p.contractor_id}, #{p.person_id}, coalesce(#{p.audit_status}, 1), now(), #{p.auditor}, #{p.remark}, #{p.creator}, true)
mapper.update: update cbs.t_contractor_person set open_status = true, audit_status = 1, auditor = #{auditor}, audit_time = now() where id = #{id}
update cbs.t_contractor_person set open_status = false where id = #{id} and open_status = true
